customManagers.description: Track the SOPS_VERSION shell variable used for curl+SHA256-verified installs — not covered by any built-in manager since it's a plain string in a run: block, not a uses:/image: field

packageRules.description: clusters/testnet/apps/exchange/ is owned by the exchange team — never open Renovate PRs against it
node-scala image pins are release pins written by pin-node-image-digest.yml / the release process, not dependency updates
gotk-components.yaml is generated by `flux install --export` (DO NOT EDIT) — only the flux manager regenerates it, never the kubernetes manager's per-image bumps
caddy-ratelimit is our own image built by build-caddy-ratelimit.yml; compose/caddy.yml's digest is bumped by hand after each build
Group Linode provider + OpenTofu version — infra-level changes reviewed together
Pin GitHub Actions to full SHA for supply chain security — Renovate keeps them current
Pin Docker and Docker Compose base images to SHA256 digests — Renovate keeps them current
Automerge GitHub Actions minor/patch SHA updates — CI gates the merge
Automerge Docker image patch updates (low risk for infra services like Caddy)
Require approval for Docker image major/minor updates — may require Caddyfile or bootstrap.sh changes
Require approval for Terraform/OpenTofu provider major/minor updates — may require tfvars or main.tf changes
Require dashboard approval for all major updates across all managers

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security vulnerability fixes — automerge immediately after CI passes
